mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a member of one particular ant colony; individual hens belong to the flock in one particular barnyard, and so on."
The individual ant is a member of one particular ant colony; individual hens belong to the flock in one particular barnyard, and so on.

The strata usually cited are the physical, the chemical, the biological and the social, but further strata may be invoked within each of these.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an attempt to explain the terms and laws of a theory of higher-level phenomena on the basis of the terms and laws of another theory of lower-level phenomena."
Theoretical reductionism is an attempt to explain the terms and laws of a theory of higher-level phenomena on the basis of the terms and laws of another theory of lower-level phenomena.

An ant colony is a highly organized social system in which the members interact with one another in complex ways, co-operating in a collective enterprise through an extraordinary degree of division of labour.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a necessity in the social sciences in several ways."
Morality is a necessity in the social sciences in several ways.

Human nature and experiences are the same all over the world and the tendency to philosophize is part of human nature.

Evil is that which obstructs the efforts of man to achieve a good and worthwhile existence.

Plato is a well-known rationalist who made a distinction between the Physical World and the Intelligible World (severally referred to as Ideal or Real World, World of Forms and Ideas).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a research strategy based on the presentation of analysis as the only scientific approach to the explanation of the higher level of organization in terms of the lower level."

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a branch of philosophy that deals with fundamental questions about the nature of reality."
Metaphysics is a branch of philosophy that deals with fundamental questions about the nature of reality.

Ontology is the study of being', as it has been understood from the time of Parmenides, Plato, Aristotle and Thomas Aquinas up to the present (Omoregbe, 1990: 45).

Cosmology is the science of reality as an orderly whole, concerned with the general characterization of reality as an ordered, law governed system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a paradigmatic form of individualism insofar as it assumes that individuals rationally pursue actions with the greatest utility."
Game theory is a paradigmatic form of individualism insofar as it assumes that individuals rationally pursue actions with the greatest utility.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the earliest to engage in philosophic criticism."
Socrates is one of the earliest to engage in philosophic criticism.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the theory of knowledge that seeks to answer questions concerning the possibility of knowledge and how knowledge claims can be justified."
Epistemology is the theory of knowledge that seeks to answer questions concerning the possibility of knowledge and how knowledge claims can be justified.
